description: Two regions with no task at all. r.cancelled is closed by a User cancel at 10 and r.plain by an ok body at 10: with no task outcome folded, the close outcome defaults to Cancelled carrying the region's own reason when the region was cancelled, and to Ok otherwise (RegionRecord::complete_close, record/region.rs:1820-1835), so an empty region is not always Ok. Read at 20 (driver observations 3 and 4).
